fisher.estimand: Conditional Gaussian mean-parameter Fisher information J_transpose_J / variance
fisher.assumptions: Known constant positive variance; independent scalar Gaussian residuals; fixed design; supplied exact mean sensitivities

gramian.estimand: Finite-horizon discrete LTI observability Gramian sum(t=0..T-1) (C A^t)^T (C A^t)

pid.estimand: Williams-Beer I_min bivariate PID of an explicitly supplied exact finite PMF

timing.boundary: Complete synchronous simulate call including controller, synthetic plant, serialization and trace hashing; excludes setup, reporting and warmup
timing.order: shuffle complete arm blocks independently per repeat and seed
